up: Retrieve activity details for compound CHEMBL221959 (TOFACITINIB) and all its salts/derivatives against target CHEMBL2971 (Tyrosine-protein kinase JAK2). Use molecule_hierarchy to expand CHEMBL221959 to include the parent and all children (salts). Match FAQ salts join semantics exactly: 1) Define the compound set by joining molecule_dictionary (parent) -> molecule_hierarchy (children via parent_molregno) -> molecule_dictionary (child). 2) Join molecule_dictionary (child) to compound_records on molregno. 3) Join compound_records.record_id to activities.record_id. 4) Join docs via compound_records.doc_id. Do NOT use activities.molregno for the activity join. Do NOT use assays.doc_id for the publication join. Filter activities by standard_type = 'IC50' and standard_units = 'nM'. Filter assays by tid corresponding to target CHEMBL2971. Return exactly: compound_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), canonical_smiles (from compound_structures joined via molecule_dictionary.molregno), compound_key (from compound_records), pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer docs.pubmed_id, fallback to docs.doi), assay_description (from assays.description), standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment (from activities), target_chembl_id (from target_dictionary.chembl_id), target_name (from target_dictionary.pref_name), and target_organism (from target_dictionary.organism). Do not limit the number of rows.
sql:
WITH related_mols AS (
  SELECT molregno FROM molecule_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL221959'
  UNION
  SELECT mh.molregno
  FROM molecule_hierarchy mh
  JOIN molecule_dictionary p ON mh.parent_molregno = p.molregno
  WHERE p.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL221959'
)
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  act.standard_type,
  act.standard_relation,
  act.standard_value,
  act.standard_units,
  act.activity_comment,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism
FROM related_mols rm
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON rm.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON md.molregno = cr.molregno
JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id
JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
JOIN assays ass ON act.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2971'
  AND act.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND act.standard_units = 'nM'
